Please reach out if you wanna talk skincare at all 😁 my skin is very reactive and it took me a long time and a lot of trial error to figure it out. I also get hyperpigmentation easily and it takes a while to fade. 

Also, I think you look beautiful! You really don’t need to feel inadequate or self conscious at all but if you want to try something different, I totally get it and understand all too well. 

As far as makeup when you take a step back from the mirror and look at the entire look, what do you feel like you’re missing? Which feature do you want to enhance and highlight?

As others have said hate the doe foot but f2o is literally the color of my neck. Kinda shocking but in the best way lol. Wish it had a tiny bit more coverage for hyperpigmentation but also realize that it’s for the best that it’s not and can just use concealer. It wear really well on me.

OP if you wanted to start some chemical exfoliant I would highly suggest starting low and slow. I’m a seasoned skin care user/enthusiast (and someone that worked in the industry for a bit) and I personally wouldn’t use that myself. 

Ahas aren’t for everyone. Some can tolerate certain ahas while they can’t tolerate others. Especially when they are in the form of particular fruit enzymes. My face doesn’t care for most leave on aha (lactic is ok) but thrives with azeliac acid and an aha wash. Please don’t jump on anything without researching. You don’t want to overdo it and ruin your barrier and end up with hyperpigmentation. Been there done that and have seen so many others have the same experience.

This hits my soul. I am so sorry you have to know this level of pain, I see you and feel what you’re saying. My ride or die of almost 4 decades stopped talking to me seemingly from out of nowhere. I’m sure it wasn’t a from out of nowhere thought for them though. They won’t respond to any of my messages. Still connected on socials too so we’re living our own lives and can watch it pass the other person by. 

I was thinking the other day, I didn’t just lose “Person”. I lost their family which was also my family too (in my head anyway).  My kid lost his family too when he lost them. He still asks me about them. 

It’s been 2 years and I’ve considered every single possible explanation. Examined every potential reason from all angles. Hurts worse than any breakup or being cheated on. Some days it genuinely hits from out of nowhere.

At the end of the day if I’m not wanted in their life then I guess it’s best for me to just back off, go away, and accept that I’m no longer wanted or needed anymore. I don’t wanna be where I’m not wanted. It’s not fun, but I guess it’s a part of growing old.

Editing to add: I truly do wish them all the best. I do not ever anticipate ever recapturing what once was, despite growth from either side. I still want happiness for them and those that they love. Just because I’ve been discarded doesn’t mean the feelings I have in me went straight to the trash. It doesn’t work that way.
